# Atlas 1.2.0 released
https://atlas.example/blog/2026-03-release-1-2

Posted 2026-03-14 by Priya Natarajan, release manager.
Atlas 1.2.0 adds export to CSV and Parquet and raises the webhook retry limit to 8.
Upgrade with: pip install --upgrade atlas-cli
Full details are in the changelog.

Links:
- https://atlas.example/docs/changelog
